description: Spanish-to-English linguistic interferences, false cognates, and habitual syntax traps

entries.realMeaning: En realidad, de hecho (In fact / really)
Darse cuenta de algo (become aware of)

entries.spanishConfusion: Sensible = Sensato / razonable (con sentido común). Sensitive = Sensible emocionalmente o físicamente.
entries.realMeaning: A sensible decision = una decisión sensata.

entries.correctForSoportar: Tolerate / Stand / Put up with ('I can't stand it')

syntacticTraps.why: Age is a state of being in English (verb TO BE), not a possession.

syntacticTraps.correction: Explain the problem TO me / Explain to me how it works
syntacticTraps.why: Explain requires preposition 'to' before the person receiving the explanation.

syntacticTraps.trap: I agree with that (pronounced 'I am agree')
syntacticTraps.why: Agree is an active verb: 'I agree', 'I don't agree'.
